title: RLC 并联电路的电流表读数与相量图
statement: U̇_s = 120∠0° V（有效值），ω = 1000 rad/s，R = 30 Ω，L = 20 mH，C = 25 µF 并联。电流表 A_1、A_2、A_3 分别串在 R、L、C 支路中，A 测总电流。
求 A_2 和 A 的读数、总电流 i 的初相，并讨论改变 C 对总电流的影响。

questions.ask: 电流表 A_2（电感支路）的读数 = ?
电流表 A 的读数 = ?
总电流 i 的初相 = ?
questions.explain: İ = 4 − j3，辐角 −arctan(3/4) = −36.87°：总电流滞后电压，电路呈感性（I_L > I_C）。

questions.ask: U̇_s、R、L 不变，只调 C。C 取多大时电流表 A 的读数最小？最小读数是多少？
questions.explain: İ = 4 + j(I_C − 6)，当 I_C = I_L = 6 A 时虚部为零，读数最小 = I_R = 4 A。I_C = ωCU = 6 A → C = 6/(1000 × 120) = 50 µF。

hints: 并联电路各支路电压相同，都等于 U̇_s。先算 X_L = ωL、X_C = 1/(ωC)，再求三个支路电流相量。
以 U̇_s 为参考：İ_R 与它同相，İ_L 滞后 90°，İ_C 超前 90°。
电流表读的是有效值，总电流要用相量形式的 KCL 求：I = √(I_R² + (I_L − I_C)²)。
solution: **4. 相量图。** İ_L 与 İ_C 反相相消，剩下 3 A 的感性分量与 4 A 的 İ_R 垂直，组成 3-4-5 直角三角形。注意 4 + 6 + 3 = 13 A ≠ 5 A。
**5. 调节 C。** 当 I_C = I_L，即 C = 50 µF 时，İ = İ_R = 4∠0° A，读数最小为 4 A（电路呈纯电阻性）。

en.title: Ammeter readings and the phasor diagram of a parallel RLC circuit
statement: U_s = 120∠0° V (rms), ω = 1000 rad/s, with R = 30 Ω, L = 20 mH and C = 25 µF in parallel. Ammeters A_1, A_2 and A_3 are in series with the R, L and C branches; A measures the total current.
Find the readings of A_2 and A, the initial phase of the total current i, and discuss how changing C affects the total current.

questions.ask: Initial phase of the total current i = ?
questions.explain: I = 4 − j3 has angle −arctan(3/4) = −36.87°: the total current lags the voltage and the circuit is inductive (I_L > I_C).

questions.ask: Keeping U_s, R and L, only C is adjusted. For which C is the reading of A smallest, and what is that reading?
questions.explain: I = 4 + j(I_C − 6); the imaginary part vanishes when I_C = I_L = 6 A, leaving the minimum I = I_R = 4 A. I_C = ωCU = 6 A gives C = 6/(1000 × 120) = 50 µF.

hints: All branches share the voltage U_s. Compute X_L = ωL and X_C = 1/(ωC), then the three branch current phasors.
With U_s as reference: I_R is in phase, I_L lags by 90°, I_C leads by 90°.
Ammeters read rms values; the total current needs phasor KCL: I = √(I_R² + (I_L − I_C)²).
solution: **2. Branch currents (U_s = 120∠0° as reference).** I_R = 120/30 = 4∠0° A (A_1 reads 4 A); I_L = 120/(j20) = 6∠−90° A (A_2 reads **6 A**); I_C = 120/(−j40) = 3∠90° A (A_3 reads 3 A).
**3. Phasor KCL.** I = I_R + I_L + I_C = 4 − j6 + j3 = 4 − j3 = **5∠−36.87° A**: A reads **5 A**, ψ_i = **−36.87°** (current lags, inductive).

**4. Phasor diagram.** I_L and I_C are in antiphase and partly cancel; the remaining 3 A inductive part is perpendicular to the 4 A of I_R, forming a 3-4-5 right triangle. Note 4 + 6 + 3 = 13 A ≠ 5 A.
**5. Adjusting C.** When I_C = I_L, i.e. C = 50 µF, I = I_R = 4∠0° A and the reading is at its minimum of 4 A (the circuit looks purely resistive).
